$Comment: How the Great Turkey fights (its role Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey, on this pack's Harvest_Feast_Template_Great_Turkey): its peck and its charge. Each time the evaluator runs it scores the actions in its one ActionSet and runs the best: Charge sends it at a player within 14 blocks at most every 12 seconds (the TargetDistance switch and the TimeSinceLastUsed SwitchPoint), with the template's telegraph (half a second locked on, a puffed-up gobble with a warning marker on the ground, then a straight run that a miss or a block ends in a daze); its weight puts it ahead of PickTarget whenever it is ready. PickTarget picks the nearest player to peck. Between those it pecks (BasicAttacks: Root_NPC_Attack_Melee with the Undead Chicken's bite, MaxRange its reach, CooldownRange the seconds between pecks, Melee_Damage's BaseDamage one peck before armour). EntityEffects gives it the souls' ghostly sheen (Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul_Glow) from the moment it rises. Tune pacing in each action's TimeSinceLastUsed SwitchPoint (seconds); the charge's hit, wind-up, run and daze sit in the template's parameters.

Charge.Description: Locks on, winds up and charges at the target
